subject: Medivance — Dedicated capacity recap & next steps
body:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>
To: Rachael O'Neill <rachael.oneill@medivance.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.inference>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.inference>
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 15:04:00 -0700
Subject: Medivance — Dedicated capacity recap & next steps

Hi Rachael,

Thanks again for the time earlier — appreciate the clear context on workloads and compliance constraints. Below is my quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before I hand off to procurement/solutions for formal pricing.

Recap of pain points and goals (as I heard them)
- Production-sensitive PHI workloads; strict isolation required for certain models (no multi-tenant mixing with PHI).
- Peak inference bursts tied to end-of-day batch scoring (18:00–20:00 local) with heavy tail traffic during business hours.
- Current infra struggles: inconsistent latency under burst, token-costs spiking with naive batching.
- Goal: stable 99th percentile latency for interactive endpoints and predictable monthly committed spend.

Dedicated capacity proposal (high level)
- Reserved pool: 10-12 x A100 (or equivalent H100 capacity) to cover steady throughput with burst headroom.
- Isolation: VPC + tenant-siloed pools for PHI traffic; optional on-prem connector for air-gapped ingest if needed.
- Autoscaling/burst path: primary reserved pool + short-duration burst credits to handle daily spikes (policy-based).
- TargetSLOs: p95 < 200ms for interactive routes; sustained throughput targets we discussed (~200k tokens/min aggregate).

Security / compliance notes
- We will include KMS integration and encrypted-at-rest logs for the PHI pool.
- You flagged SOC2 + specific SIEM ingestion requirements — sending our compliance packet with this thread.

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Confirm procurement timeline and the right procurement contact (you mentioned a contract cycle in ~3 weeks).
2) Can you confirm whether the initial scope needs on-prem connector or if VPC-only is sufficient to start?
3) I attached a one-pager + MOP draft for initial sizing — please share with your engineering/procurement team.

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-sow-v1.pdf (one-pager + SOW highlights), medivance-mop.xlsx (ops & sizing worksheet)

If that aligns, I’ll have Ben put together a formal commercial term sheet + initial SOW for review and route a DocuSign for the committed-pool option.

Thanks — speak soon.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0127

---

From: Rachael O'Neill <rachael.oneill@medivance.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>
Cc: Medivance Procurement <procurement@medivance.com>
Date: Sun, 09 May 2027 17:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Medivance — Dedicated capacity recap & next steps

Hi Vanessa — thanks for the summary, that matches our notes. Quick answers inline below: 

- Procurement timeline: target decision window is 3–4 weeks; procurement lead is Liza Martin (cc’d separately).
- On-prem connector: not required for initial rollout; VPC with audit logging is acceptable to start. We will need an option for an on-prem connector in the contract but can defer implementation.
- Compliance packet: please send SOC2 artifacts and any SOC2 + encryption checklist to our security@medivance.com.

Next ask from our side: please provide a ballpark committed-monthly price for the 10–12 GPU pool + burst credits so our finance team can provision an initial TCO.

Rachael
Director, Data Products
Medivance Health
rachael.oneill@medivance.com

Subject: Re: Medivance — Dedicated capacity recap & next steps

Appreciate the quick reply — attaching the SOC2 + compliance checklist and a very high-level cost bracket for committed capacity to give finance something to model. 

Ballpark commercial (very rough, final will depend on term / support tier)
- 12x A100 reserved pool (12-month term): $XX,XXX / month committed + metered burst credits.
- Optional premium SLAs (4 hr P1 response, 99.9% monthly uptime) available for an uplift.

Actioning: Ben will draft a formal quote & SOW today; Stephanie will coordinate the compliance packet and send the Drive links. I’ll route the DocuSign for signature once Ben confirms numbers.

Attachments included with this message: redwood-dedicated-sow-v1.pdf, medivance-mop.xlsx

Vanessa

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.inference>

Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:32:00 -0700
Subject: [Internal] Medivance — next actions (quote + compliance)

Ben / Steph — quick internal checklist from thread: 
- Ben: please create a term-sheet for 12x A100 reserved, 12-month, with burst credits line item + premium SLA option. Include an early-termination prorated refund clause per standard RW template.
- Steph: please drop SOC2 artefacts + encryption checklist into the Drive link and ping security@medivance.com. Also confirm whether our KMS integration docs need reformatting for them.
- Vanessa: route quote + SOW to Rachael and procurement; include HubSpot deal RW-2027-MEDV-042 and DocuSign link.

I’ll be on standby for any questions Rachael or Liza raise. Keep the thread intact when you reply so we have full context in the mailbox.

Thanks — V.
